# Copilot Instructions for Python Learning Project

<!-- Use this file to provide workspace-specific custom instructions to Copilot. For more details, visit https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-customization#_use-a-githubcopilotinstructionsmd-file -->

## Project Context
This is a Python learning workspace focused on:
- Python fundamentals and best practices
- Deep learning with PyTorch
- Data science and machine learning
- Hands-on coding exercises and projects

## Code Style Guidelines
- Follow PEP 8 Python style guide
- Use type hints where appropriate
- Include docstrings for functions and classes
- Prefer clear, readable code with meaningful variable names
- Add comments for complex algorithms or logic

## Learning Focus Areas
- Python basics: variables, data types, control structures
- Object-oriented programming concepts
- NumPy for numerical computing
- Pandas for data manipulation
- Matplotlib/Seaborn for visualization
- PyTorch for deep learning
- Jupyter notebooks for interactive learning

## Project Structure
- `/01_python_basics/` - Core Python concepts
- `/02_data_science/` - NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib
- `/03_pytorch_basics/` - PyTorch fundamentals
- `/04_deep_learning/` - Neural networks and advanced topics
- `/05_projects/` - Practical applications and projects
- `/notebooks/` - Jupyter notebooks for interactive learning

When generating code:
1. Provide clear explanations for beginners
2. Include practical examples
3. Add exercise suggestions
4. Use progressive difficulty levels
5. Include best practices and common pitfalls
